label: D2 after choosing a2 and landing (rare) in S1, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and only after the agent chose a2 (in_action == 2; 100% of mass). 88% of the mass is on rare a2 -> S1 transitions, and the rest is on a2 -> S2 common D2 steps right after a rare a2 -> S1 trial (decaying carry-over, about 0.3 to 0.55 of max). Magnitude grows across consecutive a2 -> S1 rare trials (for example 0.6, 0.84, 0.95, 1.0). It is also strongly gated by position in the episode: it never fires on trials 0-2 or after about trial 50, and most mass is on trials 10-30, so it is only active in a window of the episode where the hidden state (and the value output, 7.1 to 7.5) is in a particular range. It never fires after a1 choices, at D1 or GO, or when reward input is 1. The previous reward does not explain it. Best dev F1 was 0.58 (with ep_trial 3..34); the recorded ep_trial < 40 version scores dev F1 0.55, mass recall 0.87. Precision is limited because many a2 -> S1 D2 steps in the same trial range stay silent, and these are often episodes that start with S1 good. All variables are observed at D2.
